title: setGimbalAxes
description: Sets absolute gimbal axis targets in degrees and leaves the gimbal in fixed mode. Azimuth targets are normalized to 0-360 degrees.

type.description: Command discriminator. Use canonical 'setGimbalAxes' in newly generated commands.

observer.description: Observatory/site name that owns the target actuator or sensor.

axes.description: Absolute gimbal axis values in degrees, commonly az and el.
